words.example: Therefore, we should make our health a priority, because prevention is better than cure.
We should maintain good personal hygiene every day.
This is because athletes serve as role models who show what hard work can achieve.
Football is accessible to everyone because it needs only a ball.

words.word: unite people from all walks of life
words.example: Sports have the power to unite people from all walks of life.
A great match can spark an interest in the sport.
Fans may lead a more active lifestyle as a result.
Unfortunately, many people judge others by appearance.
As a result, some develop low self-esteem, while others boost their confidence by dressing neatly and staying fit.
True beauty comes from within, not from looks alone.
